metadata.title: World Rabies Day
metadata.description:
🐾 **Rabies: Protecting Your Pets & Community** 🐾
🐾 **Let’s Unite for Our Furry Companions!** 🐾

On this World Rabies Day 2024, let’s come together to safeguard the well-being of our beloved pets. Through responsible guardianship, regular vaccinations, and compassionate care, we can stop the spread of rabies and work towards a cruelty-free world for animals. Every action—whether it’s adopting, fostering, or simply raising awareness—makes a difference!

To mark this special occasion, the Veterinary Department and Health Department of the Government of Meghalaya are launching a **free rabies vaccination campaign** for both pets and stray dogs, starting from **23rd September**. Let’s stand united in protecting our furry friends and ensuring a safer, more compassionate environment for them.
